proposed_widenings.name: passive (ClassFeatureMechanics family)
proposed_widenings.justification: Superior Critical is a permanent always-on modifier with no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no reset cadence. The existing ClassFeatureMechanics only has the 'activation' family, which requires all three. A new 'passive' family is needed for features that silently modify combat resolution without being activated.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18–20 on the d20.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_crit_threshold
proposed_widenings.justification: The mechanic widens the d20 range that counts as a Critical Hit from 20 to 18–20. No existing v4 effect atom covers this. TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md §12 notes 'crit_window distinct from on_hit_window' as a deferred residue atom (single-feat pressure from Boon of Irresistible Offense). Superior Critical and Improved Critical (L3) now add two more pressure streams for this atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: can now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18–20 on the d20

notes: Superior Critical is purely passive — it permanently modifies the attack roll critical threshold with no activation, resource, or reset. ClassFeatureMechanics has no passive family. Even if a passive family were added, the effect (modifying the crit range) has no v4 atom. Improved Critical (fighter L3) encodes the same shape at 19–20; both features exert pressure for the same two widenings.
